stem: Talbot Media's architecture team is reviewing a workload that calls DynamoDB from private subnets and also replicates a nightly batch file to a second Region purely as an extra off-site copy that no application currently reads. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Create a gateway endpoint for DynamoDB in the VPC
Enable AWS Global Accelerator to speed up the nightly replication job
Confirm whether the nightly cross-Region copy is still needed before continuing to pay for it
Add more read capacity to DynamoDB to absorb the private-subnet calls
Replace the cross-Region copy with a same-Region VPC peering connection

rationale: A gateway endpoint removes the DynamoDB calls from the NAT/internet path with no additional charge. Confirming whether the cross-Region copy is actually needed matches the practice of treating a multi-Region path as a deliberate decision rather than a default. Global Accelerator improves routing performance for TCP/UDP endpoints, it does not reduce or remove the inter-Region data-transfer charge for a batch replication job. Adding DynamoDB read capacity does not change how the traffic is routed or reduce its transfer cost. A same-Region peering connection cannot substitute for placing a copy in a different Region.
